usedFor: StoreHippo holds store orders and customers and YCloud sends the mail, so a “New Order” can trigger “Send an Email”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in StoreHippo, then “Send an Email” in YCloud
bestTemplate.why: Each new order sends the customer an email through your YCloud account.

watchOut: An email to a customer waits in Needs you for your approval before “Send an Email” goes out.
